Move
Drag sideways on the board or the strip below it
Rotate
Tap right half for clockwise, left half for counter-clockwise
Drop
Drag down slowly to ease down, flick down to drop
Armory
Tap a slot to choose the next weapon
Cannon
When the gauge is full, tap it to fire a cannonball into the top 4 cells of 3 columns
Kegs
Point a musket's muzzle straight at a powder keg to blow a 3×3 hole
Broadside
Fire the Cannon 3 times to earn one. Tap it, then tap FIRE! as the side cannon passes the rows you want gone

Keyboard: ← → move · ↓ ease down · ↑ or X rotate · Z rotate back · Space drop · 1/2 Armory · C cannon · B Broadside · P pause
